request: Multiple complete SRE specialists work concurrently, post their own replies/status and collaborate in the same conversation.
changes: Dependency-ready independent roles run concurrently, one active step per fixed role. Actions are exclusive, dependencies and per-resource dispatch locks remain in force.
sre_team_update publishes runtime-bound role messages and directed peer review requests. sre_team_read returns bounded status/messages and authorized current-task recorded sources.
Every model round sees a bounded current team board; collected sources are persisted immediately for peers to read before the collecting specialist finishes.

Role progress remains independently live; final replies append at finish time. Directed recipient names render inline. Progress/team messages do not repeat the full evidence/operation journal; a live approval appears once per role run.
First failure cancels and drains all in-flight roles before the parent session is released. Shared claims/sources do not count as fresh independent verification.
